scope: Joint scenario definitions with customer-specific volume, market and exercise conditions. Operating EV is quantified; contingent claim fair value and common-equity price are not. These are not probability-weighted scenarios or legally verified forecasts.
cashflow_policy: Operating forecasts remain before customer equity rebates. Future grant costs remain in EBIT. Do not also deduct contra-revenue for the same customer claim.
retired_v1_grid: The independent 0/160/320 grid is not used in this version. A combined 160 is no longer used without identifying which customer and conditions.

deployment_delay.label: Binding initial deployments fulfilled, no later expansion and all warrant exercise conditions fail
deployment_delay.stock_path: By each deadline at least one necessary vesting/exercise condition fails for every tranche. This is an assumed failure state, not an inference from current unvested status.
deployment_delay.technical_commercial: Assume remaining required exercise conditions never all become satisfied; initial binding purchases still fulfill.

purchase_path.general_revenue_constraint: OpenAI recognized sales plus Meta recognized sales plus CPU and other GPU sales must equal total Data Center sales. Qualifying shipment/delivery is not automatically the accounting recognition date.
purchase_path.customer_revenue_mapping: Unspecified. Purchases, shipment/delivery and accounting recognition must be reconciled; no universal dollars per GW is inferred.
purchase_path.bound_caveat: An upper feasibility bound only under an additional same-year, equal-unit-revenue assumption. It is not an estimated selling price and leaves zero residual CPU/other sales at the bound. Actual unit revenue must be below this bound to leave room for those businesses.

platform_scale_upside.label: Both programs fully completed and all exercise conditions satisfied before expiry
platform_scale_upside.stock_path: Assume AMD actual market price meets both final $600 thresholds and every applicable measurement/stock-performance condition by September 30, 2030. platform_scale_upside.technical_commercial: Assume all purchases, technical/commercial and regulatory conditions are satisfied in time, with cash exercise September 30, 2030. No Meta extension is needed.
